about: The parity corpus check_unused_crates.py was retired against (DR28, plan:203), through real cargo-shear: unused normal, build, dev, target-specific and renamed dependencies, a dev-only use of a normal dependency and an unused optional dep: feature are each one `<crate>: <dependency>` site; a used optional dependency, a build dependency named in build.rs, a target dependency under its cfg, a renamed one used by its key and a #[macro_use] crate are none. The script reported the same seven sites (F2-c2 probe: old and new violation sets diff empty)
